verdict.rationale: ADP documents API Central, which offers OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect access, use-case templates and the stated aim of letting developers 'automate HR processes' with real-time data sharing. That is the product's own programmatic surface, but nothing in the pack shows API operations for creating a worker, setting compensation or configuring tax withholding, or confirms API Central covers RUN. The documented new-hire onboarding (employee self-service paperwork, W-4, electronic I-9) is UI-driven. Missing for 10: documented API endpoints for employee/new-hire creation, for compensation setup and for tax/W-4 setup; confirmation that API Central applies to RUN; hands-on evidence of an agent completing end-to-end onboarding via the API.
